scope: Recorded finite organizer-image instruction counts for the 128-copy jump-table blocks; not a production execution or a proof of collision probabilities.
environment: curvesma-reference-count (gcc Debian 14.2.0-19, valgrind 3.24.0, linux/arm64); -O3 -fno-tree-vectorize -mgeneral-regs-only -static; one fixed input file per batch size for both builds.
model: delta = 4*B/8 - 4*B/128 - 3, including the three-instruction net jump-table dispatch; B=65536 gives -30717 and B=1048576 gives -491517.

checks.dump_check: n=1 (skip) and n=64 (plain and anchor) walk dumps are byte-identical between base8 and n128
checks.dispatch: six instructions per block call: lsr, and, adr, ldrsw, add, br; the 128-entry .word table maps lane offset v to copy (-v) mod 128
